llama_cpp.release_provenance_note: v0.5.0 is an annotated tag: tag object c13fcbf684171d5e0bca3fc5c34be6a99174b05f points to source commit 7fe450e19305b828c199d602c23a8337aaa1f03b. Deployment checks out the annotated tag target and records the release-API metadata separately.
llama_cpp.post_release_compare_note: GitHub repository comparison shows the three post-release commits touched an OpenCL source file, a test source and a workflow; no CPU/OpenBLAS runtime fix needed from those three commits was identified for this deployment.
llama_cpp.build: native CPU, OpenBLAS, GGML_NATIVE=ON, CUDA/Vulkan off, static llama libraries; not a full-static executable
llama_cpp.openblas_note: official docs describe CPU OpenBLAS as prompt-processing acceleration for sufficiently large batches; generation speed is not guaranteed
llama_cpp.server_prompt_cache: disabled with --cache-ram 0 and --no-cache-idle-slots because this deployment has one slot/one active agent conversation; in-slot prefix reuse remains available and host cache adds no intended benefit for this topology
llama_cpp.context_checkpoint_scope: not disabled in v6; this is a separate mechanism and requires target qwen35moe/CPU soak before any correctness/performance tradeoff change
llama_cpp.tag_signature: GitHub tag object currently reports unsigned; source integrity relies on immutable commit pin plus build/image receipts, not a claimed tag signature.

powershell.scope: Linux PowerShell 7 in Debian 12 agent container; not Windows PowerShell 5.1 certification

host.planned_cpu_note: Intel lists 8C/16T, DDR4 and AVX2; performance still requires target benchmark
host.disk_gate: 90 GiB DATA + 5 GiB generic root before Docker + 20 GiB on Docker-reported DockerRootDir after daemon start
host.provenance_receipt: target captures CPU model(s), logical CPU count, kernel, AVX2 visibility, visible RAM, Docker version and base image platform; READY binds hashes

security_defaults.host_gateway_note: plain --internal is insufficient to remove host bridge gateway reachability; v10 requires gateway_mode_ipv4=isolated and validates the inspected network option
security_defaults.internal_bridge_ipv6: explicitly disabled with docker network create --ipv6=false; inspect must report EnableIPv6=false; live model-container inspect must not expose GlobalIPv6Address
security_defaults.dual_stack_rationale: Docker Engine 27+ daemon default-network-opts can enable IPv6 by default for custom bridge networks; IPv4 and IPv6 gateway modes are separate. This deployment intentionally stays IPv4-only to keep the isolated-gateway proof simple and deterministic.
security_defaults.seccomp_profile: explicit Docker builtin via --security-opt=seccomp=builtin; not inherited from daemon default
security_defaults.seccomp_runtime_gate: READY requires model /proc/1/status Seccomp=2 and agent isolation smoke CT_AGENT_SECCOMP_MODE=2; model inspect must list seccomp=builtin
security_defaults.host_runtime_lock_dir: /run/cybertiel mode 0700 root:root; operation/log-ingress flock files live only below this private directory
